details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary demonstrates strong internal logical coherence. All statements build upon each other without contradictions. The narrative flows logically from overall performance to specific drivers (loan growth, interest rates), geographic segments, and forward-looking guidance. Key relationships are maintained consistently: the 2024 profitability increase is attributed to high interest rates (S1, S6), while the anticipated 2025 decline is linked to upcoming rate cuts (S16, S17). Segment performances (Estonia, UK, asset management, insurance) are presented as complementary components of the whole group. While S17 mentions a 'short-term decline in profits expected in 2025,' this is properly framed as a forward-looking projection rather than a contradiction of 2024 results. The summary avoids unnecessary repetition and maintains clear organizational structure from past performance to future outlook.
